title: Saratoga Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: This home has well-appointed kitchen and open concept family room. With its 20-foot high windows, built-in bookshelves, and fresh white paint, this area exudes elegance and warmth. The kitchen, adorned with abundant quartz countertops, is fully stocked for both the culinary enthusiasts and those opting for a delightful take-out experience from one of Seaside's exceptional restaurants. The spacious living area provides ample room for your entire group to gather, dine, engage in game nights, and enjoy the full entertainment center equipped with wifi-enabled speaker systems. The cottage boasts two grand southern porches that span the entire length of the home, allowing you to bask in the refreshing sea breeze and enjoy moments of privacy and relaxation. The ground floor houses a spacious master bedroom with a king bed, large closet, and desk. Upstairs, you'll find two bedrooms—one featuring two queen beds and a recently renovated en suite bathroom—and the other showcasing a second king bed and a private, recently renovated bath. Each bedroom is equipped with a private television and French doors that open directly onto the porches.
